title: Microsoft invests €15M in Mistral AI

sources.quote: As part of the partnership, Microsoft is investing €15 million ($16.3 million at today’s exchange rate) in the French startup.

explain: Microsoft made a small €15 million (about $16.3 million) investment in Mistral as part of a deal to offer Mistral's models on its Azure cloud. It was small in money but drew attention from European regulators.
